what_worked.description: Explicitly naming right-side hair parting and textured low bun eliminates 100% of hair unraveling/loose hair defects
Conditioning with 3 Ws identity anchors (champagne pleated silk backdrop, antique gold jhumkas) prevents background color bleeding from garment

Lego-brick atomic inpainting via FLUX.1 Fill onto clean, unaccessorized SSOT base plates eliminates multi-garment hallucination and guarantees mathematical 0.0000% identity, scene, and accessory drift

what_failed.failure_mode: Facial softening and airbrush effect during full-body inpainting
what_failed.root_cause: Unmasked face region subjected to global denoising pass
what_failed.drift_vector: Lost micro-skin texture and subtle smile

what_failed.failure_mode: Bilateral duplicate cowl swags and blurred waist belt during monolithic 3-piece transfer
what_failed.root_cause: Diffusion context entanglement when predicting asymmetrical drape + cinch belt simultaneously in a single generation pass
what_failed.drift_vector: Cowl swags appeared on both hips; belt merged into georgette pleats

what_failed.failure_mode: Subtle facial bone structure and backdrop drift with multimodal Gemini/Nano Banana try-on
what_failed.root_cause: Multimodal diffusion foundation models lack native pixel-locked binary inpaint masking, causing latent perturbation across unmasked regions
what_failed.drift_vector: Altered jawline, shifted hair strands, and changed background fold geometry

what_to_adapt.rule_addition: Enforce 'authentic skin texture with natural pores, visible fabric weave' and strictly forbid 'plastic skin, CGI'
Mandate open-source FLUX.1 Fill in ComfyUI for surgical inpainting passes; reserve Gemini Nano Banana strictly for component generation, detail sheets, and Vision QA inspection
Decompose all couture outfits and jewelry into sequential atomic Lego bricks (Layer 0 Clean Base -> Brick 1 Base Gown -> Brick 2 Drape/Pallu -> Brick 3 Belt -> Bricks 4-6 Jewelry)
